_note: The text of the how-to video. Each scene: how many seconds it lasts, the English text, and the Khmer text. \N means a new line. Please ask a Khmer speaker to check the Khmer.

scenes.km: របៀបរៀបចំ\NTikTok Saver

scenes.en: 1. Press “Download the app”.\NThen unzip the file:\Nright-click, Extract All.
scenes.km: ១. ចុច “Download the app”។\Nបន្ទាប់មកពន្លាឯកសារ៖\Nចុចខាងស្តាំ រួចចុច Extract All។

scenes.en: 2. Install Node.js (free).\NChoose the LTS version.\NDo this only once.
scenes.km: ២. ដំឡើង Node.js (ឥតគិតថ្លៃ)។\Nជ្រើសកំណែ LTS។\Nធ្វើតែម្តងប៉ុណ្ណោះ។

scenes.en: 3. Open the folder.\NDouble-click setup.bat.\NType Y, press Enter.
scenes.km: ៣. បើកថត។\Nចុចពីរដងលើ setup.bat។\Nវាយ Y ហើយចុច Enter។

scenes.en: 4. Double-click the\NTikTok Saver icon\Non your Desktop.
scenes.km: ៤. ចុចពីរដងលើរូបតំណាង\NTikTok Saver\Nលើ Desktop របស់អ្នក។

scenes.en: 5. Choose the site.\NPaste the link.\NPress Download.
scenes.km: ៥. ជ្រើសរើសវេទិកា។\Nបិទភ្ជាប់តំណ។\Nចុច Download។

scenes.en: Only save your own videos,\Nor videos where the\Nowner says OK.
scenes.km: រក្សាទុកតែវីដេអូរបស់អ្នកផ្ទាល់\Nឬវីដេអូដែលម្ចាស់អនុញ្ញាត។
